study_design: Case-control study of prostate cancer cases and controls
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The case-control design was employed, involving 496 PCa cases and 496 controls aged 35 and above.
reason: The abstract compares prostate cancer cases with controls but does not analyze an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incident prostate cancer endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Advanced age, cigarette and hookah use, alcohol consumption, processed food intake, chemical exposure, obesity, poor dietary habits, stress, and reduced sleep duration were more prevalent in the PCa group (p < 0.05).
estimate_classifications.reason: This is an alcohol comparison between overall prostate cancer cases and controls; no aggressive subtype is identified.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Hypocalcemia (p < 0.001), vitamin D deficiency (p < 0.001), elevated uric acid levels (p < 0.001), increased ferritin (p = 0.005), and elevated systolic blood pressure (p = 0.004) were identified as key risk factors.
estimate_classifications.reason: Vitamin D deficiency is evaluated in relation to overall prostate cancer, without an aggressive endpoint.
